<p dir="auto"><strong>SuperAgentX</strong>: is an open-source, modular agentic AI framework that enables AI agents to plan, act, and execute real-world workflows—with built-in human approval, governance, and auditability.
Unlike traditional chatbots, SuperAgentX is designed for action, not just conversation.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">✨ Why SuperAgentX?</h2><a id="user-content--why-superagentx" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ✨ Why SuperAgentX?" href="#-why-superagentx"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">SuperAgentX enables AI agents to:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Execute multi-step workflows</li>
<li>Interact with browsers, APIs, databases, tools & MCPs</li>
<li>Pause for <strong>human approval</strong> before sensitive actions</li>
<li>Persist execution state, memory, and audit logs</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">All while keeping humans firmly in control.</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">asyncio</span>
<span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">json</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">superagentx</span>.<span class="pl-s1">agent</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Agent</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">superagentx</span>.<span class="pl-s1">agentxpipe</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">AgentXPipe</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">superagentx</span>.<span class="pl-s1">browser_engine</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">BrowserEngine</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">superagentx</span>.<span class="pl-s1">llm</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">LLMClient</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">superagentx</span>.<span class="pl-s1">prompt</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">PromptTemplate</span>


<span class="pl-k">async</span> <span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">main</span>():
    <span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s">"SuperAgentX – Food Checkout & Payment Automation"</span>)

    <span class="pl-c"># ------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
    <span class="pl-c"># LLM SETUP</span>
    <span class="pl-c"># ------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">llm</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">LLMClient</span>(
        <span class="pl-s1">llm_config</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>{
            <span class="pl-s">"model"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"gemini/gemini-3-pro-preview"</span>,
            <span class="pl-s">"temperature"</span>: <span class="pl-c1">0.1</span>
        }
    )

    <span class="pl-c"># ------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
    <span class="pl-c"># AGENT 1: FOOD & SNACKS CHECKOUT AGENT</span>
    <span class="pl-c"># ------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">checkout_system_prompt</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"""</span>
<span class="pl-s">    You are a food & snacks checkout agent. Simulate Food & Snacks Checkout with items.</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Task:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Select food and snack items</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Decide quantities</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Calculate total amount</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Prepare checkout summary for payment</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Rules:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - DO NOT generate any payment or card details</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - DO NOT mention CVV, card numbers, or expiry</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Output ONLY valid JSON</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    JSON Schema:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    {</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "items": [</span>
<span class="pl-s">        {</span>
<span class="pl-s">          "name": string,</span>
<span class="pl-s">          "category": "food | snack",</span>
<span class="pl-s">          "quantity": number,</span>
<span class="pl-s">          "price_per_unit": number</span>
<span class="pl-s">        }</span>
<span class="pl-s">      ],</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "currency": "USD",</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "total_amount": number,</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "checkout_note": string</span>
<span class="pl-s">    }</span>
<span class="pl-s">    """</span>

    <span class="pl-s1">checkout_prompt</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">PromptTemplate</span>(<span class="pl-s1">system_message</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s1">checkout_system_prompt</span>)

    <span class="pl-s1">checkout_agent</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">Agent</span>(
        <span class="pl-s1">name</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"Food Checkout Agent"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">role</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"Food & Snacks Checkout Planner"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">goal</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"Prepare checkout summary"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">llm</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s1">llm</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">prompt_template</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s1">checkout_prompt</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">max_retry</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">1</span>
    )

    <span class="pl-c"># ------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
    <span class="pl-c"># AGENT 2: BROWSER REVIEW & PAY AGENT</span>
    <span class="pl-c"># ------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">browser_system_prompt</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"""</span>
<span class="pl-s">    You are a browser automation agent responsible for review and payment.</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Input:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - You will receive a checkout summary JSON from the previous agent.</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Target Payment Form URL:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    https://superagentxai.github.io/payment-demo.github.io/</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Task:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    1. Review checkout summary (items & total) and MUST set the price from result.total_amount</span>
<span class="pl-s">    2. Show checkout summary in the popup with price</span>
<span class="pl-s">    3. Generate DUMMY credit card details for testing:</span>
<span class="pl-s">       - 16-digit test card number</span>
<span class="pl-s">       - Future expiry (MM/YY)</span>
<span class="pl-s">       - 3-digit CVV</span>
<span class="pl-s">       - Realistic cardholder name & address</span>
<span class="pl-s">    4. Fill the payment form using generated card details</span>
<span class="pl-s">    5. Submit the form</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Rules:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Change the Price value in the submit button with the actual amount from result.total_amount in USD:.</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Card details must be generated ONLY by you</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Use dummy/test card numbers only (e.g., 4111 1111 1111 1111)</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Do NOT persist card data</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Do NOT assume submission success</span>
<span class="pl-s">    - Extract confirmation text ONLY if visible</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">    Output JSON:</span>
<span class="pl-s">    {</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "submission_status": "success | failed",</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "reviewed_total_amount": number,</span>
<span class="pl-s">      "confirmation_text": string | null</span>

import json
from superagentx.agent import Agent
from superagentx.agentxpipe import AgentXPipe
from superagentx.browser_engine import BrowserEngine
from superagentx.llm import LLMClient
from superagentx.prompt import PromptTemplate


async def main():
    print("SuperAgentX – Food Checkout & Payment Automation")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # LLM SETUP
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    llm = LLMClient(
        llm_config={
            "model": "gemini/gemini-3-pro-preview",
            "temperature": 0.1
        }
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # AGENT 1: FOOD & SNACKS CHECKOUT AGENT
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    checkout_system_prompt = """
    You are a food & snacks checkout agent. Simulate Food & Snacks Checkout with items.

    Task:
    - Select food and snack items
    - Decide quantities
    - Calculate total amount
    - Prepare checkout summary for payment

    Rules:
    - DO NOT generate any payment or card details
    - DO NOT mention CVV, card numbers, or expiry
    - Output ONLY valid JSON

    JSON Schema:
    {
      "items": [
        {
          "name": string,
          "category": "food | snack",
          "quantity": number,
          "price_per_unit": number
        }
      ],
      "currency": "USD",
      "total_amount": number,
      "checkout_note": string
    }
    """

    checkout_prompt = PromptTemplate(system_message=checkout_system_prompt)

    checkout_agent = Agent(
        name="Food Checkout Agent",
        role="Food & Snacks Checkout Planner",
        goal="Prepare checkout summary",
        llm=llm,
        prompt_template=checkout_prompt,
        max_retry=1
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # AGENT 2: BROWSER REVIEW & PAY AGENT
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    browser_system_prompt = """
    You are a browser automation agent responsible for review and payment.

    Input:
    - You will receive a checkout summary JSON from the previous agent.

    Target Payment Form URL:
    https://superagentxai.github.io/payment-demo.github.io/

    Task:
    1. Review checkout summary (items & total) and MUST set the price from result.total_amount
    2. Show checkout summary in the popup with price
    3. Generate DUMMY credit card details for testing:
       - 16-digit test card number
       - Future expiry (MM/YY)
       - 3-digit CVV
       - Realistic cardholder name & address
    4. Fill the payment form using generated card details
    5. Submit the form


    Rules:
    - Change the Price value in the submit button with the actual amount from result.total_amount in USD:.
    - Card details must be generated ONLY by you
    - Use dummy/test card numbers only (e.g., 4111 1111 1111 1111)
    - Do NOT persist card data
    - Do NOT assume submission success
    - Extract confirmation text ONLY if visible

    Output JSON:
    {
      "submission_status": "success | failed",
      "reviewed_total_amount": number,
      "confirmation_text": string | null
    }
    """

    browser_prompt = PromptTemplate(system_message=browser_system_prompt)

    browser_engine = BrowserEngine(
        llm=llm,
        prompt_template=browser_prompt,
        headless=False  # set True in CI
    )

    browser_agent = Agent(
        name="Review & Pay Agent",
        role="Browser Payment Executor",
        goal="Review checkout and pay using credit card",
        llm=llm,
        human_approval=True,   # governance point
        prompt_template=browser_prompt,
        engines=[browser_engine],
        max_retry=2
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # PIPELINE: AGENT 1 → AGENT 2
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    pipe = AgentXPipe(
        agents=[checkout_agent, browser_agent], # Sequence Agent Workflow
        workflow_store=True
    )

    result = await pipe.flow(
        query_instruction="Checkout food and snacks, then review and pay using credit card."
    )

    formatted_result = [
        {
            "agent_name": r.name,
            "agent_id": r.agent_id,
            "goal_satisfied": r.is_goal_satisfied,
            "result": r.result
        }
        for r in result
    ]

    print(" Final Result (Formatted JSON)")
    print(json.dumps(formatted_result, indent=2))
    return


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Key Features</h2><a id="user-content-key-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Key Features" href="#key-features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">🚀 <strong>Open-Source Framework</strong>: A lightweight, open-source AI framework built for multi-agent applications with Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) capabilities.</p>
<p dir="auto">🎯 <strong>Goal-Oriented Multi-Agents</strong>: This technology enables the creation of agents with retry mechanisms to achieve set goals. Communication between agents is Parallel, Sequential, or hybrid.</p>
<p dir="auto">🏖️ <strong>Easy Deployment</strong>: Offers WebSocket, RESTful API, and IO console interfaces for rapid setup of agent-based AI solutions.</p>
<p dir="auto">♨️ <strong>Streamlined Architecture</strong>: Enterprise-ready scalable and pluggable architecture. No major dependencies; built independently!</p>
<p dir="auto">📚 <strong>Contextual Memory</strong>: Uses SQL + Vector databases to store and retrieve user-specific context effectively.</p>
<p dir="auto">🧠 <strong>Flexible LLM Configuration</strong>: Supports simple configuration options of various Gen AI models.</p>
<p dir="auto">🤝 <strong>Extendable Handlers</strong>: Allows integration with diverse APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes, IoT streams, and more, making them accessible for function-calling features.</p>
<p dir="auto">💎 <strong>Agentic RPA (Robotic Process Automation)</strong> – SuperAgentX enables computer-use automation for both browser-based and desktop applications, making it an ideal solution for enterprises looking to streamline operations, reduce manual effort, and boost productivity.</p>
